stem: Which statement about PNH is false?

options.A: The treatment of marrow failure in PNH parallels that of SAA, the presence of a PNH clone does not change the treatment algorithm of SAA
options.B: Transplantation in PNH could be considered in case of thrombosis occurrence to reduce the morbidity of disease.
options.C: Nowadays the room for HCT in PNH seems limited, since the treatment of complement-mediated hemolytic anemia and of thromboembolic PNH;
options.D: Since PNH is a nonmalignant disease, GVHD should be spared and thus strategies to prevent GVHD must be preferred.

ebmt_chapters: Ch78 Acquired Bone Marrow Failure: Severe Aplastic Anemia and Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (PDF p695–703)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:手冊 Ch78 原文:「Transplantation in PNH should **not** be performed in case of thrombosis occurrence because of the high risk of toxicity」,B 把它反過來說「可考慮移植以降低 morbidity」,故為錯誤敘述。A(PNH 的骨髓衰竭治療比照 SAA,PNH clone 不改變 SAA 演算法)、C(補體抑制劑問世後 HCT 在 PNH 的角色有限)、D(PNH 為非惡性疾病,不需 GvL,應優先避免 GVHD)三句都是手冊逐字敘述。

stem: Which of the following statement is incorrect?

options.A: In B cell malignancies, CD19 loss has been noted in up to 40% of patients with B cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia treated with different CAR 19 products
options.B: In B-ALL with rearrangement of the MLL gene, some patients relapsed with clonally related AML after treatment with CD19 CAR-T cells, adding a switch to a CD19-negative myeloid phenotype as another mechanism of resistance
options.C: In DLBCL, alternatively spliced CD19 mRNA species could be identified as one of the CAR-T resistant mechanisms
options.D: In multiple myeloma, relapsed patients are often observed to have decreased levels of soluble BCMA (sBCMA) in the blood, thereby impairing the sustained activity of CAR-T cells.

ebmt_chapters: Ch61 Mechanisms of Immune Resistance (PDF p550–553)
Ch60 Cellular Therapy with Engineered T Cells, Efficacy, and Side Effects: Gene Editing/Gene Therapy (PDF p541–549)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 medium),理由:手冊 Ch61(Mechanisms of Immune Resistance)只談 allo-HCT 後的 HLA loss / 微環境,未涵蓋 CAR-T 抗原逃脫;此題出自 EBMT/EHA CAR-T Handbook 的 resistance 章節。A:B-ALL 接受各種 CAR19 產品後 CD19 loss 可達約 40%,正確。B:MLL(KMT2A)重排 B-ALL 在 CD19 CAR-T 後 lineage switch 成 clonally related AML(Gardner 2016),正確。C:CD19 alternative splicing(Sotillo 2015)在 B-ALL 與 LBCL 皆有報告,正確。D 方向寫反:MM 復發病人常見的是血中 **soluble BCMA 上升**(sBCMA 可作為 decoy、干擾 CAR-T 持續作用),不是下降,故 D 為錯誤敘述。

stem: Which of the following statements regarding CAR T cell therapy for relapsed or refractory B ALL is incorrect?

options.A: Consolidative allogeneic stem cell transplantation in complete remission after tisagenlecleucel therapy has been associated with superior long-term survival in adult B ALL.
options.B: As of 2024, no CD19 directed CAR T cell product has been granted FDA approval for use in adult patients with relapsed or refractory B ALL.
options.C: Obecabtagene autoleucel, a 41BB zeta autologous CAR T cell construct with a fast off rate CD19 binder, has demonstrated high response durability in phase 1 and 2 studies, with a relatively low incidence of grade 3 or higher cytokine release syndrome or neurotoxicity.
options.D: Fractionated infusion strategies, administering part of the CAR T cell dose on Day 0 and the remainder after several days, have been explored to mitigate cytokine release syndrome and are supported by clinical trial data.

ebmt_chapters: Ch72 Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Adults (PDF p642–650)
Ch60 Cellular Therapy with Engineered T Cells, Efficacy, and Side Effects: Gene Editing/Gene Therapy (PDF p541–549)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:手冊 Ch72 明寫:「Tisagenlecleucel is approved for children and younger adults up to 25 y.o. … **Brexucabtagene autoleucel is approved for patients ≥26 years old**」(FDA 2021 核准 brexu-cel 用於成人 R/R B-ALL;2024/11 又核准 obe-cel),故 B「2024 年止無任何 CD19 CAR-T 獲 FDA 核准用於成人 R/R B-ALL」為錯。A:tisa-cel 後 CR 期鞏固性 allo-HCT 在成人與較長存活相關,手冊亦建議「subsequent allo-HCT as consolidation should be considered in patients who have not had a previous HCT」。C:obe-cel(41BB-ζ、fast off-rate CD19 binder,FELIX 試驗)反應持久且 ≥G3 CRS/ICANS 少,正確。D:分次輸注(Day 0 給部分、數日後給其餘)以減少 CRS 有 Penn/UCL 試驗資料支持,正確。

stem: Which of the following statements regarding CAR T cell therapy for relapsed or refractory DLBCL is incorrect?

options.A: Refractoriness to the last line of chemotherapy is a major adverse prognostic factor, although some real-world data suggest its impact may be partially mitigated in patients with low tumour volume at apheresis.
options.B: High tumour burden, whether measured as sum of product diameters or total metabolic tumour volume on PET, is consistently linked to inferior progression free survival, yet certain patients with elevated LDH still achieve durable responses.
options.C: Antibody–drug conjugates, including polatuzumab vedotin combined with bendamustine and rituximab, are among the validated bridging strategies, though response rates vary and high-intensity bridging has been correlated with early relapse.
options.D: Bridging therapy uniformly improves outcomes, and patients bridged with systemic chemotherapy have demonstrated longer progression free survival than those bridged with radiotherapy.

ebmt_chapters: Ch60 Cellular Therapy with Engineered T Cells, Efficacy, and Side Effects: Gene Editing/Gene Therapy (PDF p541–549)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 medium),理由:手冊 Ch86 僅概述 CAR-T 在 R/R LBCL 的地位,未討論 bridging 與預後因子;依 CAR-T 文獻(EBMT/EHA CAR-T Handbook、真實世界資料)判斷。A:對最後一線化療 refractory 是不良因子,低腫瘤量者影響較小,正確。B:高腫瘤負荷(SPD 或 TMTV)與較差 PFS 一致相關,但部分 LDH 升高者仍有持久反應,正確。C:Pola-BR 為已驗證的 bridging 之一,反應率不一,高強度 bridging 與早期復發相關,正確。D 錯:bridging 並**不**一致改善預後(需要 bridging 者本身疾病較兇、預後較差),而且資料顯示放射治療 bridging 的 PFS 並不劣於、甚至優於全身化療 bridging,「化療 bridging 的 PFS 較長」與實證相反。

stem: Which of the descriptions about HSCT for patients with mantle cell lymphoma is TRUE?

options.A: Auto-HSCT has contributed significantly to the improvement of the prognosis of mantle cell lymphoma (MCL).
options.B: The benefit of high-dose cytarabine for MCL patients before auto-HSCT has not been confirmed in a prospective clinical trial.
options.C: The majority of MCL patients who received a second HSCT underwent the tandem auto-HCT, not allogeneic-HSCT.
options.D: Auto-HSCT in first remission could also be considered in low-risk MCL patients.
options.E: It is very likely that TP53-mutated MCL patients would benefit from high-dose chemotherapy and auto-HCT.

answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:A 正確:手冊 Ch87 原文「the refinement of dose-intensified approaches such as auto-HCT has contributed significantly to this development(預後改善)」。B 錯:HD-ARAC 的好處「could be confirmed in a prospective clinical trial(Hermine et al. 2016, MCL Younger)」。C 錯:EBMT 登錄研究中二次移植者**大多數**做的是 allo-HCT,第二次 auto 只佔 2%,且不建議。D 錯:MIPI 低風險病人「very unlikely that a consolidating auto-HCT further improves outcome」,應被質疑而非考慮。E 錯:「It seems also unlikely that TP53-mutated MCLs benefit from high-dose chemotherapy and auto-HCT」。

stem:
Which of the following statements regarding non-HLA immunogenetic factors and HCT outcomes is (are) correct?
(1) Minor histocompatibility antigens (mHAgs) are the main targets of T-cell alloreactivity in HLA-identical transplant and contribute to both GVHD and GVL.
(2) Educated NK cells recognizing ‘missing-self’ HLA ligands mediate potent GVL effects, especially in HLA-mismatched or haploidentical HCT.
(3) MICA and MICB are nonclassical MHC class I genes that can be considered in donor selection.
(4) The MICA Val/Met-129 SNP affects NKG2D binding affinity and has been linked to GVHD, relapse, and survival after transplantation
ebmt_chapters: Ch12 Donor Selection for Adults and Pediatrics (PDF p143–155)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:四條皆為手冊 Ch9 非 HLA 免疫遺傳段落的直述。(1) 真:mHAgs 是 HLA-identical 移植中 T 細胞 alloreactivity 的主要標的,廣泛表現的 mHAg 同時造成 GVHD 與 GVL。(2) 真:「Educated NK cells … strongly reactive against cells missing that ligand. This missing-self reactivity is at the basis for the potent GVL effect … in particular haploidentical HCT」。(3) 真:「MICA and MICB are nonclassical MHC class I genes」,Key Points 列 MIC 為與 HCT 預後相關、可納入捐者評估的非 HLA 因子。(4) 真:「The SNP Val/Met at position 129 of MICA results in isoforms with high (Met) and low (Val) affinities for NKG2D … role in HCT outcome, including GVHD, relapse, and survival」。故 (1)(2)(3)(4) 全對。

stem:
一位19 歲女性B ALL 病人。Bcr/Abl 偵測不到。有high level IKAROS。初發病時無 CNS 侵犯。在接受完整的GRALL 處方後復發。經inotuzumab ozogamicin 和 blinatumomab 後達CR2。欲進行異體造血幹細胞移植。在donor 選擇和conditioning regimen 的設計上，以下敘述何者正確
(1) 只要親屬間有HLA 半相合以上者就可以當捐者
(2) 以HLA 全合的捐者為優先
(3) Total body irradiation (TBI) containing 的conditioning regimen 是標準建議處方
(4) HBsAg( + )但HBV DNA undetectable 的捐者是適合的
ebmt_chapters: Ch72 Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Adults (PDF p642–650)
Ch12 Donor Selection for Adults and Pediatrics (PDF p143–155)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 medium),理由:19 歲 Ph(−) B-ALL CR2 擬 allo-HCT。(2) 真:手冊 Ch72 建議表 Donor 排序「MSD > (MUD = MMUD = Haplo)」,HLA 全合優先。(1) 真(相對):同表將 haplo 列為可接受捐者,親屬半相合即可作為捐者(當然仍需 DSA 等評估,敘述較絕對,是分歧點)。(3) 真:同表「<45 years: TBI/CY; TBI/VP16 … TBI probably associated with lower relapse rates, cumulative 12–13 Gy」,年輕 ALL 標準為 TBI-based MAC。(4) 假:手冊 Ch49「An HBsAg(+) donor transmits HBV to the recipient in 22–44% of cases」,須對捐者抗病毒治療並對受者預防,HBsAg(+) 捐者只在別無選擇時勉強使用,不是「適合的」捐者;HBV DNA 測不到不改變 HBsAg(+) 的傳染風險評估。故 (1)(2)(3) → A。

stem:
About graft-versus-host disease, which are true in the followings?
(1) Graft-versus-host disease is a result of an alloimmune effect.
(2) The major risk for occurrence is the presence of HLA disparity and increasing degrees of HLA mismatching.
(3) Older patient age and the use of female donors for male recipients will increase the probability of more severe acute graft-versus-host disease.
(4) Traditional prevention regimen of graft-versus-host disease consists of a combination of cyclosporine, cyclophosphamide and methotrexate.
(5) Tacrolimus and methotrexate is not a standard regimen for prophylaxis of graft-versus-host disease.
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:(1)(2)(3) 皆為手冊 Ch43 §43.3 原文:「As aGvHD is a result of an alloimmune effect, the major risk for occurrence is the presence of HLA disparity and increasing degrees of HLA mismatching … Other important and consistent risk factors include older patient age, the use of female donors for male recipients」。(4) 假:傳統預防是 **CSA + MTX**(Storb 1986 的 gold standard),cyclophosphamide 不在傳統組合裡(PTCy 是近年 haplo 的作法,且不與 MTX 併用)。(5) 假:手冊 Ch26 明寫「the TAC/MTX regimen is currently considered as the American gold standard」,TAC/MTX 是標準方案。故 (1)(2)(3) → C。

stem:
Which factors are major contraindications or relative cautions for administering high-dose melphalan (Mel200) conditioning?
(1) Age > 70 years
(2) Estimated glomerular filtration rate < 30 mL/min/1.73 m²
(3) Eastern Co-operative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≥ 3
(4) Prior exposure to >6 cycles of lenalidomide
ebmt_chapters: Ch11 Evaluation and Counseling of Candidates (PDF p131–142)
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 medium),理由:手冊 Ch81:「fit patients up to age 70, and even 75 years old, receive AHCT」,>70 歲不是絕對禁忌但屬相對謹慎、常改 Mel140,(1) 算 relative caution 為真。(2) 真:「Renal impairment, per se, is not a contraindication … with the recommendation for the use of 140 mg/m2 of Melphalan」,eGFR<30 時 Mel200 需減量,為 Mel200 的相對禁忌。(3) 真:ECOG ≥3 為 auto-HCT 的一般禁忌(手冊列 performance status 為評估因子)。(4) 假:lenalidomide >6 cycles 影響的是 **幹細胞動員/採集**(應改用 G-CSF+plerixafor 或早採),與 Mel200 conditioning 的禁忌無關。故 (1)(2)(3) → A。分歧點:題目把「>70 歲」與「ECOG≥3」混為 Mel200 專屬禁忌,其實是整體移植適應性;但四選項中只有 A 同時排除 (4) 又包含 (2)。

stem:
針對中度或重度慢性移植物抗宿主病 (cGVHD) 的第一線全身性治療策略，以下哪些敘述是正確的？
(1) 建議使用初始劑量為1 mg/kg Prednisone or methylprednisolone。
(2) 類固醇與鈣調磷酸酶抑制劑 (CNI) 聯合使用對於嚴重 cGVHD 特別值得考慮。
(3) Rituximab 聯合類固醇和 CNI 作為第一線治療，有機會可以提高response rate
(4) Sirolimus 可與Prednisone聯合使用，顯示出與 CNI 相似的反應率。
answer_note: AI 暫定答案(信心 high),理由:四條都是手冊 Ch44 §44.4.1 First-Line Therapy 的原文。(1) 真:「For moderate or severe cGVHD, systemic treatment with PRD or methylPRD at an initial dose of 1 mg/kg body weight/day should be used」。(2) 真:「The combination of steroids with a CNI (CSA or TAC) is particularly worth considering for severe cGVHD」。(3) 真:「Rituximab has been explored in the first-line treatment … in combination with steroids and CNI demonstrating an increased response rate(~75%)on the expense of increased late infections and delayed B-cell recovery」(Table 44.1,但無隨機資料)。(4) 真:「sirolimus may also be combined with prednisone showing identical response rates compared to CNI (Carpenter et al. 2018, BMT CTN 0801)」。故 (1)(2)(3)(4) → E。
